tft-skill.description: This project's own skill design database - 'Hero Query' tab lays out per-hero skill data in the same Step/Trigger/Action/Effect shape the C# skill system mirrors. Source of truth for authoring/debugging any hero's SkillSO.

roster.description: MagicSchool Roster - the 30-hero / 10-trait design grid built from the 32rogues art. Mirrors .claude/docs/hero-roster.csv and hero-traits.csv. Separate from tft-skill on purpose: tft-skill stays the per-hero SKILL/step data, this holds the roster shape (cost, class, origin, sprite) and trait breakpoints.

tft-set9.description: TFT Set 9 Champions reference sheet (real ability text/stats this project's kits are adapted from).

tft-set9-analysis.description: TFT Set 9 Carry and Combat Efficiency Analysis sheet (separated).
